no_adcom_quote.quote: Your application for Nexletol was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary; there were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No FDA advisory committee was convened for NDA211616 (Nexletol/bempedoic acid). The approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting discussion, and the Integrated Review's Advisory Committee Summary section is marked 'N/A'. There were therefore no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
